en_title: Forza Motorsport Director and Turn 10 Boss Dan Greenawalt Retiring From Microsoft After 27 Years
cn_title: 据报《极限竞速》总监将从微软退休
subtitle: 27年旅程将落幕
opus_summary: 据报道，《极限竞速》总监将从效力27年的微软退休，内部备忘录已确认此事。他参与创建Turn 10，执导的八款系列作品横跨四代XBOX主机，IGN评分均不低于8分。

paragraphs.en: Dan Greenawalt, a 27-year Microsoft employee who helped build Turn 10 Studios from scratch and directed eight Forza Motorsport games spanning all four Xbox console generations, is retiring from Microsoft, according to a new report.
paragraphs.cn: 据最新报道，在微软任职27年的Dan Greenawalt即将退休。他曾参与从零创建Turn 10工作室，并执导了八款《极限竞速》系列游戏，作品横跨四代XBOX主机。

paragraphs.en: The Verge's Tom Warren reports that he's seen an internal memo that confirms Greenawalt's departure. “Dan Greenawalt has decided that this is the right time for him to retire from Microsoft,” said Playground Games studio head Trevor Williams. Playground, who develops the Forza Horizon franchise, was merged with Greenawalt's Turn 10 last month as part of Xbox's ongoing " reset ."
paragraphs.cn: The Verge记者Tom Warren报道称，他看到的一份内部备忘录确认了Greenawalt即将离职的消息。Playground Games工作室负责人Trevor Williams表示：「Dan Greenawalt认为，现在是从微软退休的合适时机。」作为XBOX持续「重整」的一部分，开发《极限竞速：地平线》系列的Playground已于上个月与Greenawalt所在的Turn 10合并。

paragraphs.en: Williams added, in part, "It’s hard to overstate Dan’s impact over the past 27 years. From shipping Project Gotham Racing on the original Xbox in 2001 to leading the creation of Forza, founding Turn 10 Studios and appearing so many times on our E3 stage, usually making a dramatic entrance with a supercar in tow."
paragraphs.cn: Williams还说道：「Dan在过去27年里的影响力，再怎么强调也不为过。从2001年在初代XBOX上推出《Project 哥谭 Racing》，到主导打造《极限竞速》、创立Turn 10工作室，再到多次登上我们的E3舞台——他通常都会带着一辆超级跑车，隆重登场。」

paragraphs.en: Unfortunately, it looks as though 2023's Forza Motorsport, which was meant to be a platform of sorts that would be evolved and added onto, might be the last Motorsport game for the foreseeable future, if ever, after layoffs hit Turn 10 last year and reportedly relegated the remaining team to support duty on the highly profitable Forza Horizon. Motorsport will not be getting any more new content .
paragraphs.cn: 遗憾的是，2023年的《极限竞速》原本打算作为一个持续演进、不断扩充内容的平台，如今看来，它可能会成为可预见的未来里、甚至永远的最后一款《极限竞速》正传作品。Turn 10去年遭遇裁员，据报道，留下的团队也被转为支援盈利丰厚的《极限竞速：地平线》。《极限竞速》正传将不再推出任何新内容。

paragraphs.en: Greenawalt's Forza Motorsport series consistently earned critical acclaim, with all eight games scoring an 8 out of 10 or higher at IGN.
paragraphs.cn: Greenawalt执导的《极限竞速》系列一直广受媒体好评，八款游戏在IGN的评分均为8分或以上。

paragraphs.en: Ryan McCaffrey is IGN's executive editor of previews and host of IGN's weekly Xbox show, Podcast Unlocked , and a co-host of Next-Gen Console Watch . He's a North Jersey guy, so it's "Taylor ham," not "pork roll." Debate it with him on Twitter at @DMC_Ryan .
paragraphs.cn: Ryan McCaffrey是IGN前瞻内容执行主编，也是IGN每周XBOX节目《Podcast Unlocked》的主持人及《Next-Gen Console Watch》的联合主持人。他来自新泽西州北部，所以他把那种猪肉卷叫作「Taylor ham」，而不是「pork roll」。你可以在X上通过@DMC_Ryan与他辩论这个问题。
